deviations.what: t5 additionally provides a shared DL_DIR/SSTATE_DIR outside the repo and a flock-serialized build wrapper (os/scripts/bb.sh) so wave-2 recipe agents queue their bitbake runs through one build instead of N parallel build dirs
deviations.reason: N parallel bitbake builds would each need a full build dir and thrash the Spark; user approved at gate 2 ('wrapper yes')

deviations.what: t2 acceptance criterion says 'verifies --version' but arduino-flasher-cli has no --version flag for its own version (--version selects an image to flash); the script uses the 'version' subcommand instead
deviations.reason: criterion was worded from the flash doc's --version image selector; the tool's own version check is the 'version' subcommand

deviations.what: t11 local access drops adbd: the no-network shell is a USB CDC-ACM serial console plus the UART console on ttyMSM0, both requiring the provisioned non-root user's login password; no unauthenticated root path
deviations.reason: meta-oe adbd has authorization disabled, so adbd = root shell for anyone at the USB port; conflicts with t12 hardening (risk r11). Operator chose 'Login consoles'.

deviations.what: t12 adds ostree_%.bbappend (PACKAGECONFIG ed25519-libsodium) in its own recipe dir, a file its brief does not name
deviations.reason: target and native ostree have no signature engine (r10); sign-verify=true cannot work without it; verified refusal/acceptance with the image's own ostree

deviations.what: t8 arduino-router talks to the MCU via the stable udev symlink /dev/ttySTM0 (udev rule: tty with idVendor 1209 idProduct ca01, as the factory 99-stm-tty.rules) instead of the raw /dev/ttyACM0 named in t8's criterion and c11/c27
deviations.reason: factory board (read-only ssh): 10-monza generator drop-in runs --serial-port /dev/ttySTM0; 99-stm-tty.rules symlinks the STM32 USB-ACM device 1209:ca01; ttyACM0 is only correct when the MCU is the first ACM device
